name: Ovsiankina effect
fact: The Ovsiankina effect is the tendency for individuals to resume interrupted or unfinished tasks.
boundary: The effect describes behavioral resumption rather than memory recall.

provenance.title: Interruption, recall and resumption: a meta-analysis of the Zeigarnik and Ovsiankina effects
